scopedCoverageNotes.text: Kings County official specimen judicial candidate coverage contains8 local races: Supreme Court District2, county Civil Court and municipal court districts2/3/4/6/7/8. Six municipal court races were missing from held New York data. The2 countywide judicial contest identities are reused. Five held citywide charter proposals were also checked against the specimens and remain unchanged outside this candidate installation.

No Kings mayoral, borough-president, county prosecutor, city-council, school or special-district candidate contest appears in the current BOE Kings general-election inventory checked. The full public source manifest lists922 English sample styles; selected specimens cover every local judicial candidate field enumerated by that current inventory, but every style has not been independently compared for late additions.

Blank write-in slots are not people. Separate declared write-in certification remains coverage work. Exact municipal court district and Supreme Court territory joins need held registry/reader geography; no municipal court district is widened to Kings County.
